description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmployeeSalaryDao' within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for CRUD operations and queries related to employee salary data, such as saving, deleting, and fetching salary records, as well as counting and paginating results based on filters.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing EmployeeSalary entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and pagination within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeSalary entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Deletes an EmpDirectDebit entity from the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeSalary records based on employee number and a list of salary IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeSalary record matching employee number and salary ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeSalaryIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of existing EmployeeSalary IDs for a given employee and list of IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Fetches a list of EmployeeSalary records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeSalary records matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for EmployeeSalary records based on filter parameters, including sorting and pagination.
